title: How do I move certificate of deposit money out of a Savings & Money Market Accounts account into the owner's checking account?
content:
## Situation and policy

This policy applies when the owner of a Savings & Money Market Accounts account asks to move out of that account the money that the certificate of deposit which most recently paid into it put there. A request about the money of any other certificate is outside this policy.

- The transfer is a telephone withdrawal to the owner's own checking account at Piedmont Crescent Bank, and its amount is the certificate money still held in the account.
- The withdrawal is subject to every rule of the savings withdrawal allowance and withdrawal limits on the day it posts.
- Because the owner instructs it by telephone, the withdrawal is customer-initiated activity for dormancy purposes.

## Business effect

One withdrawal posts on the savings account through the telephone banking channel, with a new posting trace number, naming the receiving checking account as the other side of the transfer. The savings account's current balance goes down by the amount at once. The withdrawal's posted date is the business day it posts: the current date when that is a business day (Monday through Friday, other than a Federal Reserve holiday), otherwise the next business day. The withdrawal then shows in the account's activity.

## How it is invoked

The tool is transfer_savings_to_checking_5f60835b. It is a customer-side tool: it must first be unlocked and handed over, to be run by the customer themselves. It is the customer's own instruction to move their money during the call.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| savings_account_id | the reference number of the savings or money market account the money leaves, as returned by the savings account lookup | identifier |
| destination_checking_account_id | the reference number of the customer's own checking account that receives the money, as returned by the checking account lookup | identifier |
| amount | the amount moved | USD, 2 decimal places, always positive |
| statement_cycle | the statement cycle in which the withdrawal posts | YYYY-MM, the month in which the statement cycle that contains the withdrawal's posted date closes |

The tool records the values it is given; it does not work out the amount.

## Return

A successful call returns a receipt with:

- savings_txn_id: the reference number of the posted withdrawal; a returned savings_txn_id means the withdrawal posted;
- posted_date: the business day the withdrawal posted, YYYY-MM-DD;
- amount: USD with 2 decimal places;
- channel: always telephone_banking;
- trace_number: a 15-digit posting trace number;
- new_balance: the savings account's current balance after the withdrawal, USD with 2 decimal places.

## Contract Q&A

**Can the channel be chosen?** No; the tool always posts through telephone_banking.

**Which date does the withdrawal carry?** The business day it posts; there is no date parameter. On a business day that is the current date; on a Saturday, Sunday or Federal Reserve holiday it is the next business day.

**Illustrative call (hypothetical values):** savings_account_id of the account, destination_checking_account_id of the owner's checking account, amount 1500.00, statement_cycle 2025-04. The receipt echoes the amount with channel telephone_banking and a new savings_txn_id.
